purpose: This silver table provides a cleaned registry of individual aircraft, one row per tail number, drawn from the FAA aircraft registry subset used by the nycflights13 planes dataset, for joining to flight records by tail number.
usage: Join downstream flight data on tail_number, the declared grain key; treat manufacture_year and speed_mph as nullable measures and handle missing values explicitly rather than assuming completeness, since both carry substantial null rates.
limitations: speed_mph is populated for only about 0.7% of rows (null_rate 0.993076, 3299 of 3322 rows null) and manufacture_year is missing for 2.1% of rows (70 of 3322 null); neither is imputed, both remain nullable, and American Airlines and Envoy Air aircraft are absent from this registry subset per the source documentation since those carriers reported fleet numbers rather than tail numbers.
